text:
omar (acct exec): Quick ask 1: AuroraHealthTech wants a 6-week dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) with a blended 55% discount across infra + inference. They say large hospital chain rollout potential. Can we approve fast? :pray:
clara (finance ops): Blended 55% is large. Need pilot size, expected token/GPU hours, and what "blended" means (line item breakouts). Also need proposed conversion ARR.
omar (acct exec): Customer expects ~200 GPU-hours + 4M tokens over 6 wks. List estimate: infra $36k, inference $18k, total list $54k. With 55% they'd pay ~$24.3k. Sales projects conversion to a 12mo committed Dedicated contract ~ $360k ARR.
ben (revops): Requesting this much discount requires concession memo and GL mapping. Recommend cap on credit = $30k and require 50% prepay or onboarding fee to secure commitment. Also need to avoid discounting infra below marginal cost.
nadia (head of finance): Short answer: not approved as-is. Finance can sign off up to 40% for Dedicated pilots without VP review. Anything >40% goes to VP of Finance. Conditions: must have deal desk ticket, signed LOI (evaluation terms), prepayment or non-refundable onboarding fee, and a hard credit cap.
kevin (legal): Legal needs SOW limiting scope, data handling addendum (if PHI), and a clause preventing term conversion without exec approval if we subsidize infra heavily. We'll review within 48h once docs are attached.
omar (acct exec): Customer will accept 40% + $10k onboarding + $30k cap if that gets it moving. Can we do 40% conditional on LOI + prepay?
ben (revops): If we go 40% we should also require a conversion KPI in the LOI (e.g., agreed POC milestones and decision date) and specify billing treatment. GL code suggestion: 5420 (pilot concessions).
clara (finance ops): I'll provisionally prepare concession memo template. Need the deal desk ticket URL, LOI pdf, SOW, and GL code confirmation. Once DEALBOT creates ticket, tag me.
deal-bot: /dealdesk create customer=AuroraHealthTech pilot_type=dedicated pilot_discount=40% pilot_cap=30000 onboarding_fee=10000 expected_ARR=360000 notes="reserved capacity test, hospital chain rollout"
finance-bot: Checklist: 1) Deal desk URL, 2) Signed LOI, 3) SOW w/ scope & data controls, 4) Confirm GL code. Finance will finalize approval once all 4 items are uploaded.
nadia (head of finance): Approve conditional: up to 40% discount; onboarding fee required; prepay or signed LOI with conversion KPI; legal signoff required. Anything above 40% must go to VP review. :white_check_mark:
omar (acct exec): Thanks team 1. Ill get LOI + SOW drafted and upload. Tagging @kevin for legal turnaround ETA 48h. Will update thread when deal ticket is live. :thumbsup:
